subject: social_science

concepts.title: Land Revenue Assessment
concepts.section: Administration under the Khaljis and Tughluqs
concepts.definition: The system of calculating and collecting taxes from agricultural produce based on land measurement and state-prescribed rates.
concepts.key_idea: State-controlled revenue collection based on land assessment.
question_patterns: calculate the revenue if total produce is ... and rate is ...
how much tax is collected if produce is ... at 50 percent rate
find the revenue amount for a yield of ...
determine the tax burden on a peasant with produce ...
compute the state share if the harvest is ...

solution_steps.action: multiply total produce by tax rate
solution_steps.explain: calculate the share of the state from the total agricultural output

concepts.title: The Circle of Justice
concepts.definition: A political theory suggesting that a king's stability depends on soldiers, whose salaries depend on peasant revenue, which in turn requires a prosperous and just peasantry.
concepts.key_idea: Interdependence of the king, soldiers, and peasants for a stable state.
question_patterns: explain the circle of justice in your own words
why did the king need to ensure peasant prosperity
what is the relationship between soldiers and revenue
describe the circle of justice concept
how does justice relate to the king's survival

solution_steps.explain: identify the link between king, soldiers, and peasants

concepts.title: Iqta System
concepts.section: Administration under the Khaljis and Tughluqs
concepts.definition: A system where military commanders were assigned territories to manage and collect revenue as salary for their military service.
concepts.key_idea: Land assignment in exchange for military service and law enforcement.
question_patterns: what was the role of an iqtadar
what were the duties of the holder of an iqta

solution_steps.explain: examine the link between revenue collection and military duty

worked_examples.question_pattern: Calculate the revenue if total produce is {total_produce} and tax rate is {tax_rate}

solution_template.explain: calculate 50 percent of the total produce

worked_examples.question_pattern: Find the revenue for a harvest of {total_produce} units at a {tax_rate} tax rate
